name: robots/jaykorea__isaac-rl-two-wheel-legged-bot
title: Isaac Lab Flamingo velocity flat constraint task
intro: Isaac Lab Flamingo velocity flat constraint task, adapted from jaykorea/isaac-rl-two-wheel-legged-bot. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
